1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 3 simultaneously live drums, 1 independent acetate leaf per drum, 85 degree half-openings, changing rates and cut-induced motor load. Visible cutter recharge keeps later cuts in the moving world.
1.natural_language: Expose each moving fuse through every acetate guard, then snip its collar. The first failed snip, incomplete seal, or engine expiry ends the episode; retries cannot earn a pass. Inspection and manual-leaf adjustments remain allowed. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
